name: Change vendors and approve payments
why: Someone could set up or change a vendor and then approve paying it.

name: Change vendor bank details and approve payments
why: Someone could point a real vendor's payments to their own bank account and approve the payment.

name: Enter invoices and approve payments
why: Someone could enter a fake invoice and approve paying it.

name: Create vendors and enter invoices
why: Someone could create a fake vendor and enter invoices from it. A separate approver still has to approve the payment.

name: Manage access and approve payments
why: Someone who can hand out access could give themselves any AP duty, and they can already approve payments.

name: View all data and export reports
why: Someone could read every record in the org and take it out in a report export.
